standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the limit of an inverse system of groups as the set of compatible families
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 5982-5990)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the limit with a subset of the product defined by compatibility of the transitions.

core_obligations: Identify the limit: the limit consists of the compatible families in the product, which is the intersection of the closed conditions expressing compatibility (proof lines 5981-5990)
Closedness: each compatibility condition is closed because the transition maps are continuous, so the intersection is closed (proof lines 5991-5994)
proof_roadmap: 极限 = 积中满足全部相容条件的元素之集 = 各相容条件的交。
每个相容条件因转移映射连续而闭 ⇒ 交闭。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the limit of an inverse system of topological groups satisfying the descending chain condition is closed in the product (author lemma at source lines 5974-5979, label lemma-topological-group-limits). The proof (source lines 5981-5995) writes the limit as the intersection of the compatibility conditions inside the product and observes that each of them is closed by continuity of the transition maps (proof lines 5981-5994). The description of the limit as an intersection of closed conditions is the content. H3.
